from pathlib import Path
base=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689824/attempts/9d615e3a66d9447e8803eb583e82b2e3/system/state/workspace/programs')
base.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    divider = 2
    cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == divider]
    if not cells:
        return out
    # A full-height divider is vertical; a full-width divider is horizontal.
    rows = {r for r, c in cells}
    cols = {c for r, c in cells}
    vertical = len(cols) == 1 and len(rows) == h
    horizontal = len(rows) == 1 and len(cols) == w
    if vertical:
        dc = next(iter(cols))
        objects = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
                   if grid[r][c] not in (grid[0][0], divider)]
        if not objects:
            return out
        side = 1 if sum(c for r, c in objects) / len(objects) > dc else -1
        target = (max(c for r, c in objects) + 1) if side > 0 else (min(c for r, c in objects) - 1)
        if 0 <= target < w:
            for r in range(h):
                out[r][target] = 8
    elif horizontal:
        dr = next(iter(rows))
        objects = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
                   if grid[r][c] not in (grid[0][0], divider)]
        if not objects:
            return out
        side = 1 if sum(r for r, c in objects) / len(objects) > dr else -1
        target = (max(r for r, c in objects) + 1) if side > 0 else (min(r for r, c in objects) - 1)
        if 0 <= target < h:
            out[target] = [8] * w
    return out
'''
p=base/'task-9919698d.py'; p.write_text(source)
exec(compile(source, str(p), 'exec'), globals())
